item.title: Version 1.5.67
item.description:
🎉 v1.5.67 Update

  • ✨ Instant Results
    - See calculations, conversions, and script results directly in the OnText panel.
    - Build the Instant Results you want to see in your panel with Create with AI.
    - Customize colors and multi-line results, then preview them with Run Test.
    - Get started with Kilometers to Miles, now available in the Action Library.
  • ⌨️ Create with AI Improvements
    - Set action shortcuts directly or request them in conversation. New actions automatically receive an available key, with confirmation before replacing an existing assignment.
    - Create Instant Results actions with AI and test their output before saving.
    - The + attachment button now sits at the bottom-left of the message composer.
  • 🌐 Language Support
    - Instant Results controls and validation messages are available in English, Korean, and Chinese.
  • 🎨 Custom Icon Colors
    - Custom action icons now keep their original colors and transparency in the icon picker and Settings previews.
